datasets.name: maintenance_priority
queryLines:
SELECT
  *
FROM
  saifur_fevm_aws_workspace_catalog.multivar_energy.gold_maintenance_priority
ORDER BY
  priority_score DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: ml_top20
queryLines:
SELECT
  *
FROM
  saifur_fevm_aws_workspace_catalog.multivar_energy.gold_ml_failure_predictions
ORDER BY
  ml_priority_score DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: ml_high_risk
queryLines:
SELECT
  *
FROM
  saifur_fevm_aws_workspace_catalog.multivar_energy.gold_ml_failure_predictions
WHERE
  ml_risk_label = 'HIGH_RISK'
ORDER BY
  ml_priority_score DESC

datasets.name: demand_actual_vs_forecast
queryLines:
SELECT
  reading_date,
  SUM(total_consumption_kwh) AS actual_kwh,
  SUM(forecasted_consumption_kwh) AS forecasted_kwh
FROM
  saifur_fevm_aws_workspace_catalog.multivar_energy.gold_demand_forecast_results
GROUP BY
  reading_date
ORDER BY
  reading_date
